headline: A cut cable disrupted hundreds of flights across the US
summary: Hundreds of US flights were disrupted due to a severed Verizon fiber cable. Construction crews in New Jersey accidentally cut the air traffic control cable. The outage heavily impacted airports across the Northeast.

headline: Amazon wants to help the Colorado River, but we still don’t know how much water the company uses
summary: Amazon pledges $20 million for Colorado River water conservation projects. The initiative comes amid scrutiny over tech companies' data center water use. Amazon's own water consumption figures remain undisclosed.

headline: California tightens rules on AI data center energy and water use
summary: California signed bills to regulate AI data center energy and water use. New laws aim to prevent utility cost burdens on residents. Data centers will face new rate classifications and pay for utility upgrades.

headline: GM can’t ‘bring back’ Apple CarPlay because it never left
summary: GM announced an updated Apple CarPlay/Android Auto experience for new trucks. This caused confusion, as GM previously removed these features from its EVs. CarPlay was never fully 'removed' from all GM vehicles, just EVs in 2023.

headline: Injustice 3 Leak Reportedly Reveals 2 Playable Characters
summary: A new leak for Injustice 3 has surfaced. It reportedly reveals two playable characters. One character is expected, while the other is a surprise.

headline: The Love Hypothesis Review
summary: The Love Hypothesis, a New York Times bestseller, received a review. It has been adapted into a charming rom-com. The adaptation's review is positive.

headline: IGN Australia and Chupa Chups to Host a Retro Gaming ‘Fun House’ Activation at Westfield Parramatta This October
summary: IGN Australia and Chupa Chups are partnering for an event. They will host a Retro Gaming 'Fun House' activation. The event takes place in October at Westfield Parramatta.

headline: Get a Lenovo Legion Go S Ryzen Z2 Go Handheld Gaming PC in Excellent Condition for Under $500
summary: A Lenovo Legion Go S Handheld Gaming PC is available for under $500. The device is described as more powerful than the Xbox Ally. It utilizes SteamOS, akin to the Steam Deck experience.

headline: Burnham expects to find 'common ground' with Trump in first meeting
summary: Prime Minister Burnham anticipates common ground with Trump in their first meeting. Burnham is in New York for the UN General Assembly. His UN speech is expected to focus on AI.

headline: UK to provide Saudi Arabia with 'defensive' military support, says Burnham
summary: Prime Minister Burnham states the UK will provide defensive military support to Saudi Arabia. Support includes defensive air-to-air refuelling. This follows Saudi Arabia's request after Houthi attacks in Yemen.

headline: Martha's Rule rolled out at every A&E department in England
summary: Martha's Rule has been implemented across all A&E departments in England. The rule is named after 13-year-old Martha Mills. It addresses situations where families' concerns about a patient's care were ignored.

headline: Lithuania ready to 'fight back' but has evacuation plans in face of Russia threats, PM tells BBC
summary: Lithuanian PM Sinkevičius states the nation is ready to 'fight back' against Russian threats. Despite threats, evacuation plans are in place. Lithuanians feel constantly threatened by Moscow, he told the BBC.
